mapping.0..2999: water autotile (Block A/B): block*1000 + b_subtile*50 + a_subtile, 4 quadrants from A rows 0..3 / B rows 4..7
mapping.3000..3149: Block C animated decoration (whirlpool etc.), 4 frames at chipset cols 3..5 rows 4..7
mapping.A:<id>: Block A/B water; frames share the row, frame files carry the #<index> suffix

animation.note: frame 0 的格位即 lower_tiles 里的坐标，右侧连续格为其余帧（水面 3 帧 / Block C 4 帧）
